definitions.gloss: to reissue; to reprint; to issue again
definitions.explanation: To issue or produce something again, such as a document, certificate, ticket, or card that has been lost, expired, or needs replacement.

examples.japanese: パスポートを{再発行|さいはっこう}する。
クレジットカードを{紛失|ふんしつ}したので{再発行|さいはっこう}してもらった。
examples.english: I lost my credit card, so I had it reissued.

examples.japanese: {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}の{再発行|さいはっこう}には{手数料|てすうりょう}がかかる{場合|ばあい}がありますのでご{注意|ちゅうい}ください。
examples.english: Please note that there may be a fee for reissuing a receipt.

notes:
A compound of {再|さい} (again, re-) and {発行|はっこう} (issuance, publishing) + する. Used for official documents, identification, financial instruments, and similar items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再発行|さいはっこう}を{申請|しんせい}する: to apply for reissuance
- {再発行|さいはっこう}{手続|てつづ}き: reissuance procedure
- {再発行|さいはっこう}{手数料|てすうりょう}: reissuance fee

THINGS COMMONLY REISSUED:
- パスポート: passport
- {免許証|めんきょしょう}: license
- {証明書|しょうめいしょ}: certificate
- クレジットカード: credit card
- {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}: receipt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {発行|はっこう}する: to issue — the original issuance
- {再交付|さいこうふ}する: to reissue (official) — more formal, used for government documents
